name: Sleuth Saga: Under Starless Skies
source: Sleuth Saga: Under Starless Skies is a murder-mystery visual novel adventure game set in a detailed fictional world with a focus on wild political conspiracy and far-reaching intrigue, featuring vibrant hand-drawn artwork and an original soundtrack designed to evoke a blend of several key influences.
translation: 《Sleuth Saga: Under Starless Skies》是一款谋杀之谜视觉小说冒险游戏，背景设定在一个详细的虚构世界中，重点关注疯狂的政治阴谋和影响深远的阴谋，具有充满活力的手绘艺术作品和旨在唤起多种关键影响的原创配乐。
